goal: Separate the 15-case privileged-graph gap into usable past feedback, feedback-wait cost and controller limitations before new policy-learning claims.

phase_one.cases: Keep all 180 cases and flag the 15 gap cases; selection is developmental, not blinded confirmation.
arms: same actor with past public fault support
phase_one.stationarity: Explicitly declare which installation response/fault conditions persist between attempts; no stable condition inferred from filenames.
phase_one.memory: Past support inferred from delivered power packets and unmasked command effects only; every label has attempt ID and global arrival time. Unknown/censored support retained.
phase_one.information_budget: Same prior attempts, sensors, decisions and action primitives; no private fault label, oracle schedule or future event enters any causal arm.
metrics: cost and failure retained from calibration attempts
phase_one.reason_count_unset: Need implementation and pilot to freeze a complete roster; no execution claim from this design.

phase_two_conditional.entry: If a reproducible causal gap remains after the same-information memory scheduler and stronger action selection, train shared history-conditioned imitation plus student-state DAgger.
phase_two_conditional.rl_or_score_distillation: Only after demonstrated remaining decision bottleneck and compatible target interfaces.

infeasible_cases: Keep the 114 scoped-infeasible cases in reporting; do not retrospectively remove them to inflate success.
oracle: Privileged offline analysis only; not a causal optimum or training label.
